# toPageMode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`PageModeInput`](page-mode-input.md) to the [`PageMode`](page-mode.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toPageMode(input: PageMode | PageModeToken): PageMode
```
